subject: planner: fix possible inconsistent output cols among union's children (#48775)
summary: Reviewed the first-parent diff: the only behavior change is in `LogicalUnionAll.PruneColumns` (column pruning). The fix prunes `UnionAll` schema by the parent-used column set (instead of mirroring child-0), and when no parent columns are used it forces `used` to all-true to avoid accidentally pruning everything; it also keeps the existing safeguard that inserts a Projection when a child outputs extra columns. This addresses the real failure mode (different children retaining different extra columns => inconsistent output columns) without changing SQL-visible semantics. Cross-checked later history: upstream/master has the same pruning logic (refactored location), no subsequent fix required.
